items.basis: Widely-circulated Jul 17 internal date passed with no launch; Bloomberg (Jul 16) reports another multi-month slip after it missed DeepMind's coding/reliability bar. Still absent from the AA board (top Google entry is 3.5 Flash). Polymarket ~73% by early Aug.
Polymarket prices GPT-6 a late-2026 story (~68% by Dec 31, ~40% by Sep 30); Manifold ~89% by Dec 2026. OpenAI's line still flows through GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) and GPT-Live voice.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus ~95% by Aug 31, ~98% by Oct 31, version unannounced.
xAI (now SpaceXAI) shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; markets price Grok 5 single-digit near-term (~16% before Sep). The 6T V9-foundation model is reportedly still training on Colossus 2.
